before: When several columns went in one drawing, a cell whose width record was taken before any one of them came kept its width for all of them, also for the column whose space it takes; a removed column's own cell gave its first width after a fold had written the space it took.
after: A cell keeps its width only for the removed cells whose space it takes (the engine's spaceReceivers) or whose column it lent width to, and a removed cell gives the width its records gave it before the decision, its own column's too.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest fields and the Yjs format do not change: every client composes the same table from the same items, and the checkpoint attribute is one the format already has. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
